items.source: Parse the path value into a sequence of "/" Separator and PathSegment elements.
items.translation: 将路径值解析为一系列"/"Separator和PathSegment元素。

items.source: The contained path elements, either PathContainer.Separator or PathContainer.PathSegment.
items.translation: 包含的路径元素，即 `PathContainer.Separator` 或 `PathContainer.PathSegment`。

items.source: Parse the path value into a sequence of Separator and PathSegment elements.
items.translation: 将路径值解析为 Separator 和 PathSegment 元素的序列。

items.source: path - the encoded, raw path value to parse
items.translation: path - 要解析的编码后的原始路径值

items.source: the sub-path
items.translation: 子路径

items.source: the parsed path
items.translation: 解析后的路径

items.source: Each PathContainer.PathSegment exposes its content in decoded form and with path parameters removed. This makes it safe to match one path segment at a time without the risk of decoded reserved characters altering the structure of the path.
items.translation: 每个 `PathContainer.PathSegment` 都以解码形式暴露其内容，并移除了路径参数。这使得逐个匹配路径段是安全的，无需担心解码后的保留字符改变路径结构。

items.source: Extract a sub-path from the given offset into the elements list.
items.translation: 从给定的偏移量中提取子路径到元素列表中。

items.source:
Extract a sub-path from the given start offset into the element list
(inclusive) and to the end offset (exclusive).
items.translation: 从给定的起始偏移量（包含）到结束偏移量（不包含），提取子路径到元素列表中。

items.source: The original path from which this instance was parsed.
items.translation: 该实例被解析的原始路径。

items.source: index - the start element index (inclusive)
items.translation: index - 起始元素索引（包含）

items.source: startIndex - the start element index (inclusive)
items.translation: startIndex - 起始元素索引（包含）

items.source: endIndex - the end element index (exclusive)
items.translation: endIndex - 结束元素索引（不包含）

items.translation: options - 用于自定义解析
